codeReview.summary: Reviewed commit 661d65a5 (87 files, +25353/-425) plus the current combined code for the Guestbook CRM, the six module reports, the bookings/waitlist_entries report subjects, GET /book/today, the App Guests/Reports screens, the bookings-today dashboard block, the Arabic catalogs and the three carried-over tenant-api fixes. No blocking defect found; every assertion family in the feature's fulfils list is backed by code. Verified: (1) every guest route is mounted under rsvGuard({scope:'guests', grant read/update:reservation_guest:any}) with ensureActiveOrgInNodeRegion; listGuests hides merged/erased rows, clamps to 50 per page, searches first/last/full name, emailNorm and >=3 phone digits, and derives first_visit/frequent_no_show; merge refuses same-id/unknown/stale/already-merged/erased, moves reservations, waitlist, notify requests, tags and notes, sums counters, releases the unique customer link, writes rsv_guest_merges, merged_guest events and day-version bumps in one transaction; export gates includeSensitive on update guest and audits guest.export without PII; erase anonymizes the profile, sends cancellation_restaurant (delivered synchronously before the contact is cleared), cancels future bookings with cancelled_by=restaurant, releases occupancies, bumps day versions, redacts events and prior audit rows while preserving row counts, and appends guest.erase. (2) reconcile_guest_counters is registered in the tick, recomputes only guests touched by recent status events (2-day window), excludes merged/erased guests and guest_erased cancels, and is idempotent (second run repaired: 0 in rsv-guest-counters.test.ts). (3) POST /internal/reservations/erase-customer takes a strict ids-only body under internal auth and unlinks customer_id/marketing_customer_id while keeping history. (4) The six module reports require read:reservation_report:any on the reports scope, validate the range (from<=to, <=366 days), return zeroed structures on empty ranges, load no guest columns, and write report.run with kind, location and range before the answer. (5) bookings and waitlist_entries are in RESERVATIONS_REPORT_SUBJECTS, spread into RESTRICTED_REPORT_SUBJECTS, hidden by catalogForGrants/definitionAllowed, dispatched in analytics.ts (403 forbidden_subject without the grant) and loaded with locationIds from the token's scopeIds; the catalog exposes no contact columns. (6) App loaders for guests, guests.$guestId and reports await requireReservationsAccess first (covered by reservations-guards.test.ts), report-access.server.ts returns NONE on impersonation/flag-off/no grant/empty scope and reports+/token.ts intersects staff and reservations scopes; guests tokens keep the 300 s sensitive TTL. (7) The bookings-today block is offered and rendered only with reservations.enabled plus read:reservation:any and location scope (maxInstances 1), fetches /operator/reservations/book/today browser-direct every 60 s, and the App loader returns only token context (no guest data). (8) Arabic .po entries are genuine translations (spot-checked Today/Guests/Erased guest/frequent no-show/late cancels); the only empty msgstr is the PO header. (9) Carried-over fixes: notify_available names the restaurant-local date and slot time and links to that slot (rsv-message-service.ts:257-300, migration 0018_rsv_notify_slot.sql, render test rsv-message-service.test.ts:618-648); the public availability ETag folds the online/waitlist bits in (reservations-public.ts:352-356); both staff tests use HIDDEN_RATE_MINOR/B2/C = 10_000_000_000 so a timestamp can no longer collide. Non-blocking observations are listed below; the reservations header controls on Guests/Reports, the unscrubbed rsv_notify_requests contact fields, the guest manage-link cancel not marking late_cancel, and guestRequests staying in the default export are all outside the approved requirements or consistent with existing surfaces.

issues.description: The shared reservations layout renders the Date and Service controls on every section, including Guests and Reports where neither filter applies (only Location does). The worker flagged this in the handoff (discoveredIssues[0]). No validation assertion covers it and the controls are inert there, so it is a UX wart rather than a contract violation; hiding them on the guests/reports routes is a future cleanup.

eraseGuestProfile scrubs waitlist entries (rsv_waitlist_entries phone/email/notes/display name) and payment card refs, but never clears rsv_notify_requests.contact_phone_e164 / contact_email_norm (packages/tenant-db/src/schema.ts:4351-4352). An erased guest's notify-me row keeps the phone/email that the same person supplied, so the erasure is not complete for that table. This code path predates the feature and no assertion in the contract requires the scrub (the architecture's erasure bullet names profile, tags, events/audit and future bookings), so it is non-blocking; worth a follow-up scrub or an explicit note in the erasure design.

The operator cancel path now marks late cancellations (rsv-booking-service.ts:2747-2756 via isLateCancellation, updating rsv_reservations.late_cancel and rsv_guests.late_cancels), but the guest manage-link cancel path (this file, lines 936-950) still writes cancelledBy='guest' and increments cancels without setting lateCancel/lateCancels. Consequence: a guest who cancels through the manage link inside the free-cancellation window is counted as a regular cancellation by the cancellations report (rsv-report-service.ts:236-241 reads the stored column) and in the Guestbook lateCancels counter. VAL-REPORT-006 is still satisfiable because the guest path cannot cancel outside the window (409 cancel_closed), so the 'one late, one regular' pair must be produced through the operator surface, which is wired; VAL-PAY-036 in milestone 10 explicitly expects the guest path to set late_cancel=1, so that milestone will need this wiring.

exportGuestProfile includes reservation guestRequests unconditionally (also in getGuestProfile at line 630) while dietaryNotes and staffNotes are gated on includeSensitive. guestRequests is guest-typed free text that the erase path nulls, but the architecture's export bullet only excludes allergy and dietary text, and the day feed already returns guestRequests to every book viewer (rsv-day-feed-service.ts:510), so this matches the documented behavior; noting the residual free-text surface in case the intended exclusion list is wider.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The app-ui-worker skill (step 5) requires live gating checks - 'a user without the permission cannot see or reach the screen' - and library/user-testing.md documents how to create a restricted operator (line 23 and the g14 recipe at lines 275-305). The worker verified live flows only as kody on acme/riyadh-grill and covered no-grant gating through tenant-api security tests, component tests and the route guards test, then flagged the gap in the handoff instead of using the documented recipe. skillFeedback.followedProcedure is true with no deviations, so the skill/feedback loop did not capture it. library/user-testing.md:181 already records the follow-up for validators, so no library change is needed; validators of VAL-GUEST-011/VAL-GUEST-013/VAL-REPORT-002/VAL-REPORT-020 must still exercise a restricted account in a second browser context.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Two product quirks discovered while building this feature are recorded only in the handoff, not in library/app-ui-patterns.md or library/user-testing.md, and both can mislead the next worker or validator: (a) the reservations layout header's Date/Service controls also render on Guests and Reports, where they do not filter anything; (b) a guest-initiated cancel through the manage link does not set late_cancel, so the cancellations report and Guestbook lateCancels counter only reflect operator cancellations. Worth a line in the relevant library file so later milestones (especially VAL-PAY-036) do not rediscover them.

No gap: the worker used the documented mission commands (test_tenant_api, test_files_app, e2e_build/e2e_spec/e2e_spec_repeat, lingui extract/check, typecheck_app, lint_app_files, seed_reservations_*) and ran no service or command outside services.yaml.

summary: PASS. The feature satisfies its assigned contract assertions (VAL-GUEST-001..021/023/026..029, VAL-REPORT-001..024, VAL-CROSS-018..021): guest routes are guard-enforced with search, cursor paging, tags, derived system tags, notes, atomic merge and gated export; erasure anonymizes, notifies before clearing, cancels future bookings, redacts without deleting history and records guest.erase; the erase-customer hook unlinks only the opaque customer ids; reconcile_guest_counters is idempotent and skips erased/merged guests; the six module reports and the two generic subjects are grant-gated, PII-free and audited; the App screens are guard-first, the reports token intersects scopes, and the bookings-today block is flag/permission/location gated with a browser-direct 60 s refresh and no guest data in the App loader; the Arabic catalogs are genuinely translated and the three carried-over fixes (notify_available slot date/time + link, ETag flag bits, stable staff-test needle) are in place with tests. Four non-blocking notes: header controls on Guests/Reports, unscrubbed rsv_notify_requests contacts on erase, guest manage-link cancels not marking late_cancel, and guestRequests in the default export.
